summary: The capability spine: the schema, registry and policy machinery that describes and enforces what each backend/dialect can do for a given operation call. Backend packages (expressions.backends.capabilities and relations.backends.capabilities) author import-safe SEGMENT declarations; bootstrap.load_all_capability_declarations discovers and binds them, and CapabilityRegistry validates and publishes them as qualified information (descriptive) and qualified policies (executable gate or materialize-residue rules). Registry lookups such as capability_for, violations_for and validate_plan_capabilities are consulted at build/compile time with a BoundCall and an execution context, so a descriptive record alone never changes execution. The package also holds cold read-only layers: capture/catalogue/gaps/retired for evidence and history, and coverage/render_markdown which build the expression coverage report.
key_classes: CapabilityRegistry — classmethod singleton: ensure_loaded, register_segment, capability_for, violations_for, residue_for, validate_plan_capabilities, snapshot/restore/reset
CapabilitySegment / BoundSegment — authoring unit of declarations and its validated scope binding
CapabilityInformation — descriptive record (level, layer, message) with no execution consequence
CapabilityPolicyRule — executable rule naming consumer, action and bounded applicability
CapabilityFact — runtime policy fact with Enforcement (GATE at BUILD, MATERIALIZE_RESIDUE at MATERIALIZE; default GATE)
CapabilityPolicy — immutable user/runtime protection preferences applied via the capability_policy() context manager
BackendIdentity / Scope / FamilyWide / Dialect — family plus dialect identity; KNOWN_DIALECTS is the allowed set
BoundCall and Predicate/Clause/ClauseOp — predicates over the whole bound call (capability is a property of the call)
ValueClass + value_classes.predicate_for — support-relevant membership classes for literal values
CoverageReport / build_coverage_report — pure model for the generated expression coverage report
ScopeReader / CatalogueQuery — immutable descriptive views, never execution authority
key_functions: load_all_capability_declarations() — discover and bind all declaration leaves from expression and relation capability roots
CapabilityRegistry.violations_for(bound_call, ...) — what forbids this call (the predicate API)
capability_policy(policy) — context manager scoping a CapabilityPolicy
render_markdown(report) / render_scoped(report) — deterministic coverage report rendering
classify_domain(operation_key) / classify_source(operation_key) — map an operation enum to Domain and FactSource

lifecycle_notes: Registry load is batch-validated and published atomically; execution queries use concrete-scope policy indexes only; information never participates in execution

risks: Descriptive fields must never decide execution (explicit-enforcement-role principle); conflating information and policy reintroduces silent gating or silently disabled gates
Known footgun: a policy `condition` is prose only and does not enable gating; compound predicates may block nothing after probe (project notes 66a/66b)
Registry is global classmethod state; tests rely on snapshot/restore/reset
schema.py (~1100 lines) and registry.py (~1250 lines) are complexity hotspots
Relation namespace changes must be gated against tests/core and protocol alignment, not only tests/relations
